summary: Xanadu Quantum Technologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a CAD $195 million conditionally repayable contribution from the Government of Canada's Strategic Response Fund to support its quantum photonics facility and supply chain expansion. The agreement, dated August 28, 2026, is between the Minister of Industry, Xanadu Quantum Technologies Inc. (recipient), and Xanadu Quantum Technologies Ltd (guarantor). The total project cost is CAD $893.355 million. The funding is contingent upon the company meeting eligible cost and project milestones, not export performance. This is a government subsidy/development agreement, not a special situation. Watch for milestone achievements and repayment conditions.
